department: School of Electrical and Computer Engineering

deadline.value: Apply by 16 December 2026 (11:59 pm ET) for Fall 2027 PhD entry in Atlanta; ECE says its deadlines are firm.
deadline.quote: Electrical & Computer Engineering Electrical and Computer Engineering Engineering Atlanta Doctoral Fall 2026 Fall 2027 12/16/2025 12/16/2026

also.quote: Are the application deadline dates firm? Yes.

gre_subject.value: There is no GRE Subject test for ECE and the pages do not mention one.

gre_general.value: GRE scores are not required but are considered if submitted.
gre_general.quote: GRE scores are no longer required. GRE scores will be considered if submitted, but are not necessary.

supervisor.value: Students choose their own research advisor; most arrive without one and pick an advisor after taking courses.
supervisor.quote: We do not assign research advisors to students; we allow students to select their own advisors. | In most cases, students arrive on campus without an advisor and select their advisors by taking courses from different faculty members

funding.value: Most admitted Atlanta PhD students get a GTA or GRA offer, stated in the admission letter; otherwise you need your own funding.
funding.quote: Most applicants admitted to the Atlanta campus Ph.D. program will receive a GTA or GRA offer. This will be noted in your acceptance letter.

entry_route.value: You do not need a master's to apply to or be admitted to the PhD.
entry_route.quote: You do not need to already have a Master's degree to apply to or be admitted to the Ph.D. program.

notes: TOEFL 90 / IELTS 7 (Institute minimums); Duolingo and TOEFL MyBest not accepted. ECE receives 2,000-3,000 applications a year.
